acceptance.given: A TC-D1 evaluation-seed artifact is presented to the repository Toolchain validator with its baseline-status and authorization fields available for validation.

oracle.expected: The validator accepts only the explicit non-authorizing-candidates baseline status together with authorizes: []; TC-D1 evaluation work therefore remains non-baseline.
forbidden: A quality baseline status or any authorization that accepts or publishes a quality baseline is accepted.
TC-D1 scope validation reports success for a quality-baseline proposal.
oracle.observable: The evaluation-artifact validation result contains the deterministic rejection that evaluation seeds must not publish a quality baseline.

acceptance.then: The scope validator rejects the proposal and emits no successful TC-D1 evaluation result.
acceptance.when: TC-D1 scope or implementation work is evaluated with a seed artifact that creates, accepts, or publishes a quality baseline.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate the evaluation-seed artifact from baseline_status: non-authorizing-candidates or authorizes: [] to a quality-baseline-publishing value; validation must reject the artifact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the TC-D1 evaluation-artifact scope validation so that any artifact creating, accepting, or publishing a quality baseline is rejected, while valid non-authorizing candidate classification remains valid.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain the existing non-authorizing-candidates and authorizes: [] contract; rollback removes only the new rejection extension and never creates or accepts a quality baseline.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposed TC-D1 artifact that creates or accepts a quality baseline transitions from pending scope evaluation to deterministic rejection; a conforming non-authorizing artifact proceeds without creating a quality baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator returns failure for every quality-baseline-publishing proposal and returns no successful TC-D1 evaluation result from that proposal.
